scope.requested: Flow-diagram component styled like supplied screenshot, adapted to house standards; robust connector arrows, curves/corners; research modern fast/light libraries.
scope.selected: Render supplied nodes/connections with automatic layout/routing, pan/zoom and controls inside nodes. No node/connection authoring or reconnecting editor in current scope.
scope.unselected: Package, public API, graph scale, nested groups, navigation, export, layout overrides and exact motion remain open.
scope.engineDecision: Use ELK for automatic graph layout and routing, with house Lit node/SVG rendering and existing TanStack Store, Lit Motion, generated styles and React wrapping same component. Load layout engine separately when needed. No X6/ReactFlow renderer or diagram editor adopted.
scope.open: Exact public interface/name/parts, graph scale, worker packaging and cancellation, measurement/relayout stability, panzoom helper, SVG rounding helper, arrow-label layout, accessible relationships, nested groups, export and override controls remain inventory/architecture work.
